videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Terry appears in court to testify against brother Ben, but reacts badly to being questioned about his own childhood abuse.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Phil's mum turns up at the station to lecture him on his responsibilities as a father-to-be. The case against Terry's brother concludes.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Part 1: Gary is shot during a raid on a gang suspected of handling stolen goods, while Gina returns to work immediately after receiving cancer treatment.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Part 2: Jack embarks on a search for the gunman who shot Gary, while Smithy and Jonathan call at Gina's house to see why she hasn't turned up for work.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Part 3: Rochelle continues her steamy illicit affair with Dan, while Adam learns the Borough Commander has been sent photos of him smoking marijuana.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Ramani discovers Terry has been having an affair with his sister-in-law, while Jack takes over as superintendent and promotes Neil Manson to acting DCI.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Part 1: Yvonne is summoned to hear her fate as the inquiry into the death of Lee Chapman concludes, and Jack is forced to arrest his own son.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: A dangerous driver in a pick-up truck causes carnage when his vehicle rolls over and the HART team are called to free him and his passenger from the wreckage.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: A hitman linked to a drugs gang guns down two men in a supermarket car park. Later, a teenage dare leads to a massive rescue operation after a boy vanishes in the water.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: A truck drives through the barrier of a busy motorway and hits a BMW head-on. The team join a delicate rescue operation to persuade a suicidal man down from a bridge.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: It's a race against time to dig out a man buried under three tonnes of soil, and the team are called to rescue the victims of a major crash involving a taxi.

videos.description: The team are called to a major fire in a chemicals factory and paramedics join firefighters desperately searching for teenagers reported missing in a swollen river.

videos.description: Laura makes a life-changing decision after suffering from post-natal depression and Anne needs an operation to remove a painful bony lump from her foot.
